posts.title: Larger Than Live
posts.description: The rockstar comparison is usually a way of saying someone is famous. That is the wrong axis. What changed for performers was two technologies, not one. Recording made the take durable. Distribution — radio, then MTV, then the internet — put that take in unlimited rooms without the performer travelling. A master in a vault is still one room. The superstar distribution is recording plus a pipe.
